messages:
Maiya: Quick heads-up — we're introducing a structured routing header to improve attribution and console joins. Header name: X-RW-Routing-Meta (JSON). Planning a canary next Tue. Need SDK emits behind a feature flag so orgs can opt in.

Oliver: Must be additive. Many edge proxies and infra still look for legacy X-Route. No forced break.

Sanjay: Runtime note: our cache key incorporates routing fields. Any change to header shape could cause churn. I propose a short-lived shim that mirrors v2 -> legacy to preserve keys while console backfills.

Jun (py-sdk): Can you share exact shape? prefer compact keys for perf. Example?

Maiya: Current v2 draft (compact):
```
X-RW-Routing-Meta: {"route":"checkout","cc":"ecom","aff":"sess-xyz"}
```
We may add a base64 compact kv form later.

Jun (py-sdk): Ok. Py plan: add env var RW_ROUTING_V2=1 and a runtime feature flag. When on, emit X-RW-Routing-Meta; when off, emit legacy X-Route. Add unit tests + an integration test that exercises both shapes and cache hit rates. PR will be feature-flagged.

Marta (go-sdk): Go will follow. We'll add a new structured emitter function but keep existing APIs so no caller changes.

Ria (ts-sdk): Browser clients cannot set custom headers in all setups. For web clients we'll document fallback to a telemetry event that the server can correlate; also discuss using Fetch with credentials for some customers.

Tess: Console needs a mapping from old fields to the new `cc` cost-center. Product wants historical continuity for 30 days so dashboards don't fragment. We'll coordinate an events backfill job.

Kate: Product/Enterprise asks for a per-org opt-in toggle in Console. Customers want time to validate traffic before the SDK default flips. Can we make the control-plane advertise an opt-in per org?

Oliver: Server handshake idea: control-plane returns RW-Routing-Mode: v2 in the Connect response for orgs opted-in. SDKs can detect that at init and toggle without a deploy.

Sanjay: We'll implement the runtime shim on edge that, during migration window, copies X-RW-Routing-Meta -> X-Route. That keeps caches stable while Console backfills.

Jun (py-sdk): Timeline question: how long will v2 be warned before default flip? We need at least 7 days to rollout client changes and get feedback.

Maiya: Timeline proposal: canary Tue -> warning logs Thu -> org toggle open Fri -> default SDK flip 7 days after canary if no regressions. If cache hit-rate delta >3% we pause the flip.

Ria (ts-sdk): We'll add telemetry counters that report header version sent; server can graph adoption. Also emit a small `routing_v2` debug flag in events for Console to surface.

Marta (go-sdk): Add forward-compat tests: servers must ignore unknown keys and SDKs must tolerate extra fields. We'll include fuzz tests to ensure parsing is robust.

Jun (py-sdk): Opening PR: https://git.redwood/pylib/pull/678 — feature flag emitter + env var + unit/integration tests. Local tests green.

sdk-ci-bot: canary deployed: https://canary.rw/eu-central (test endpoint)

Jun (py-sdk): Running integration suite against canary now. Initial run shows cache miss delta ~0.8% across sample traffic. Posting full results in RW-2331.

Sanjay: I'll watch cache hit-rate and set an alert if delta exceeds 3% after canary. If we see >3% we'll extend shim window and coordinate with Console for extra backfill.

Maiya: I created tracking ticket RW-2331 and added a checklist (py/ts/go SDK work, runtime shim, console mapping, canary schedule). Assigning: Jun (py), Ria (ts), Marta (go), Sanjay (runtime), Tess (console). Keep updates on RW-2331.

Kate: UX copy needed for admin toggle — explain cache, cost, and a rollback path. Add a dismissible warning when org toggles early.

Oliver: Small console UX ask — add a `v2` badge in attribution tiles when data arrives from the new header to help debugging mixed traffic.

Tess: We'll do that and include a timeline filter so SRE/Product can compare v1 vs v2 attribution for a selected window.

Jun (py-sdk): CI run finished: integration pass against canary, no SLA regressions. PR link above. Tagging @Oliver for review.

Maiya: Thanks all. If any team sees anomalies file them into RW-2331; we'll hold the flip if needed. Appreciate the quick coordination :party_popper:
